thread:
sre-bot: ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate detected on prod-east gateway (ingress-proxy). paging oncall.

maria: acked. looking at grafana: 5xx spike started ~08:12 UTC, peak ~08:15. spikes are primarily 502/504 from ingress -> model-serving upstream. link: https://grafana.internal/r/xyz (snippet)

ajay: any recent deploys to ingress or middleware this morning?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: service=ingress-proxy commit=ab3f9d2 env=prod-east user=ci-bot ts=1998764800

maria: yep that deploy was 06:40 UTC. logs show a jump in upstream 502s after 08:12, which is weirdly delayed. sampling responses:
```
[08:13:02] ingress: POST /v1/generate -> upstream 502 "bad gateway"
upstream response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\ncontent-type: application/json\n{ "error": "upstream request malformed" }
```

devon: runtime team — can we get tails from the model-serving nodes? look for malformed requests or header drops. also check if kv-cache or conn pool exhaustion happened.

maria: pulling tails now. initial grep shows lots of 400/parse errors between ingress and model-runtime around 08:12-08:18 with a repeating header key `X-Client-Meta` containing truncated json.

ajay: that header parsing middleware we added in ab3f9d2 touched header size handling. if header becomes too long the middleware truncates -> upstream sees invalid content and returns 502.

maria: rolling a quick mitigation: disabling header-parsing middleware on prod-east via feature flag.

maria: command:
```
# flip feature flag for prod-east
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"header_parse_v2","env":"prod-east","value":false}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress-proxy -n prod --context=cluster-prod-east
```

sre-bot: Action executed: feature flag flipped by maria at 08:24 UTC. restart launched.

maria: after restart: 5xx rate dropped from 7.2% -> 0.6% over 3m. latency normalized. looks like mitigation effective.

paul (support): support has ~18 tickets opened between 08:10-08:30, a few customer retries failed. tagging customers who reported errors: AcmeCorp, QuickShop. estimated impacted requests ~0.4% of global traffic but concentrated on prod-east.

devon: root cause hypothesis: header-parsing change truncated long `X-Client-Meta` for some customers. model-serving rejects malformed request and returns 502. latency/circuit-breaker interactions amplified the spike.

ajay: for immediate fix we should ship a small hotfix to middleware: accept larger header sizes and add graceful fallback (strip instead of truncate) + validation before proxing upstream.

maria: agree. opening hotfix PR and will do canary to prod-west first.

maria: hotfix PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingress/PR/1456 — patch: change header max-size from 8k -> 32k; on overflow return 400 to client instead of truncating.

devon: also add a temporary alert: alert when 502 ratio per-region > 1% for 5m AND deploys in last 6h — to reduce noisy pages for unrelated spikes.

ajay: note for longer-term: runbook should include steps to flip header middleware and a checklist to check deploy timestamps vs metric onset. current runbook lacks that correlation step.

maria: handing to oncall-ingress for follow-up monitoring and customer comms. @oncall-ingress please verify steady-state and add entry to incident log.

oncall-ingress: taking over. will monitor for 30m and patch SLO incident page. initial check: avg 502 rate now 0.3% for last 10m. :thumbsup:

paul (support): preparing customer message: brief apology, cause (middleware header handling), impacted window 08:12-08:24 UTC, mitigated 08:24. sending to CSMs for review.

- revert not necessary since mitigation safe (maria)

devon: proposed small code diff (excerpt):
```
// before: truncate header
if len(header) > MAX { header = header[:MAX] }
// after: validate and reject
if len(header) > MAX {
  log.Warn("header too large", ...)
  return httpError(400, "client header too large")
}
```
